item.content:encoded: I have to agree with the general consensus of posts over the past few years that the very last test is what ruins this for me. The nature of the object itself is fine, but it needs revision to bring it back into line with the Foundation being clinical, not cruel, and remembering what the 'P' in SCP stands for. This isn't the first test, the Foundation is generally aware of the nature of the gloves, and if it they were wanting to test whether the gloves could affect people not immediately in the vicinity of the wearer, then you'd just need to repeat the pinwheel test while asking the subject to think of someone far away. -1 for now

item.title: Re: Overhaul
item.content:encoded: I never read the previous version, but I like these. Starting with the pinwheel is a great, clinically appropriate detail, and I echo Sorts' comment. My only suggestion for improvement is to cut the "supernatural in origin" bit. It doesn't sound professional given the scientific bent of testing at the Foundation. Instead, I'd recommend something like, "flexibility does not conform to standard physical laws and further research is needed." Just my two cents.

item.title: Overhaul
item.content:encoded:
I originally intended to do a simple clean-up on the article to make it less unprofessional. I ended up completely redoing the entire thing, keeping only the fact that it was a pair of gloves that insulates the wearer from harm (after a fashion)

On the one hand I hope this makes it better, maybe even worth keeping. On the other hand I'm opening myself up to taking more criticism than if I'd done a simple cosmetic job and moved on. What do you think?

I'm a little uncertain about whether the experimental logs run a bit too long, bu other than that I did my best!
